content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To try some new tea, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Look up specialty tea shops online (10 minutes)
Step 2. Check the balance of your tea budget (5 minutes)
Step 3. Clear space on the tea shelf (10 minutes)
Step 4. Research the optimal water temperature for Oolong (15 minutes)
Step 5. Read reviews of different tea cultivars (1 hour)
Step 6. Select a specific tea estate to support (20 minutes)
Step 7. Organize your tea infusers and strainers (10 minutes)

Step 10. Clean the mineral deposits from the kettle (30 minutes)
Step 11. Choose a quiet time of day for the tasting (5 minutes)
Step 12. Rinse the teapot with hot water (1 minute)
Step 13. Fill the kettle with filtered water (2 minutes)
Step 14. Adjust the temperature setting on the electric kettle (30 seconds)
Step 15. Create a shortlist of potential tea flavors (15 minutes)

Step 21. Wash the tea towels (1 hour)

Step 25. Check for any discount codes or coupons (10 minutes)
Step 26. Read about the history of the tea region (1 hour)

Step 28. Place the tea leaves into the infuser (30 seconds)
Step 29. Check the expiration dates on current tea stock (15 minutes)
Step 30. Browse a tea enthusiast forum (45 minutes)

Step 40. Put on some relaxing background music (3 minutes)

Step 52. Pour the hot water over the leaves (30 seconds)
Step 53. Wait for the tea package to arrive in the mail (3 days)
Step 54. Steep the tea for the recommended time (3 minutes)
Step 55. Pour the brewed tea into the cup (15 seconds)
Step 56. Let the tea cool to a drinkable temperature (4 minutes)
Step 57. Observe the color of the tea liquor (1 minute)
Step 58. Look up the harvest date of the tea (10 minutes)
Step 59. Finalize the tea-tasting station setup (5 minutes)
Step 60. Write the name of the tea in your journal (2 minutes)
Step 61. Take a photo of the tea setup (2 minutes)
Step 62. Take the first sip of the tea (10 seconds)
Step 63. Note the initial aroma of the brew (1 minute)
Step 64. Filter the tap water (10 minutes)
Step 65. Discard the used tea leaves (1 minute)
Step 66. Research second-steep instructions (10 minutes)
Step 67. Inhale the steam from the cup (30 seconds)
Step 68. Put away any distracting electronics (2 minutes)
Step 69. Note the "mouthfeel" of the tea (2 minutes)
Step 70. Log into your favorite tea blog (5 minutes)
Step 71. Refill the water pitcher (2 minutes)
Step 72. Compare this tea to previous ones you've tried (10 minutes)
Step 73. Arrange the tea biscuits on a plate (5 minutes)
Step 74. Read the brewing instructions on the label (2 minutes)
Step 75. Listen to the sound of the water boiling (2 minutes)
Step 76. Clean the tea table surface (5 minutes)
Step 77. Plug in the kettle (10 seconds)
Step 78. Ensure the kettle is properly seated on its base (10 seconds)
Step 79. Watch a video on traditional tea ceremonies (20 minutes)
Step 80. Clear your palate with a sip of water (30 seconds)
Step 81. Unbox the tea carefully (5 minutes)
Step 82. Read a book about tea pairings (1 hour)
Step 83. Check the mailbox for the delivery (5 minutes)
Step 84. Stir the tea gently (10 seconds)
Step 85. Close the curtains for better lighting (2 minutes)
Step 86. Select a tea-tasting playlist (10 minutes)
Step 87. Record the vendor's name (1 minute)
Step 88. Clean the tea strainer (5 minutes)
Step 89. Remove the tea from the shipping envelope (2 minutes)
Step 90. Double-check the tea-to-water ratio (2 minutes)
